title: 11 May 2011: Paul McCartney live at Estadio Nacional, Santiago, Chile
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Estadio Nacional Julio Martínez Prádanos in Santiago, Chile, on 11 May 2011.

It was the 35th concert of the Up And Coming Tour, which lasted for 38 dates between March 2010 and June 2011.

The concert followed Monday’s performance in Lima, Peru, and came ahead of two sold-out dates in Brazil later in the month.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney previous played the Estadio Nacional on 16 December 1993 during the New World Tour, and 20 March 2019 during the Freshen Up Tour.
